title: Best AI Visibility Tools in 2026: 10 Platforms Compared
excerpt: Compare the best AI visibility tools for 2026: features, AI platforms covered, starting prices and free options for 10 platforms, plus how to choose.
author: AI Brand Track Team
content:
The best AI visibility tools in 2026 track how ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and Google's AI answers mention, rank and describe your brand against competitors. For enterprise teams, [Profound](https://www.tryprofound.com/pricing), [Scrunch](https://scrunch.com/pricing) and [AthenaHQ](https://www.athenahq.ai/pricing) pair broad engine coverage with enterprise controls such as SSO and API access. SEO teams already on [Semrush](https://www.semrush.com/kb/1493-ai-visibility-toolkit) or [Ahrefs](https://ahrefs.com/brand-radar) can add those vendors' AI visibility products. [Otterly.AI](https://otterly.ai/pricing), [Rankscale](https://rankscale.ai/pricing) and [LLMrefs](https://llmrefs.com/pricing) are lower-cost subscriptions, and AI Brand Track (our product) is a pay-as-you-go option that also offers a 14-day Starter trial for $9. The right pick depends on which AI platforms matter to you, how many prompts you need to track, and whether you want a subscription.

*Last updated October 2026. Features and prices change, so check each vendor's site before you buy. We took the details below from each vendor's own website. We did not run benchmark tests, and we don't publish ratings.*

**Disclosure:** AI Brand Track is our product. We've included it alongside competitors and described its limitations as plainly as theirs.

## How to choose an AI visibility tool

In our experience, most AI visibility platforms do the same basic job: send prompts to AI assistants, record the answers, and report whether your brand appears. The differences are in the details below.

1. **Platforms covered.** List the assistants your buyers actually use. If Google AI Overviews matters to you, make sure the tool tracks it. Not all do, and some charge extra per engine ([Otterly.AI](https://otterly.ai/pricing), for example, sells Gemini, AI Mode and Claude as add-ons).
2. **Prompt volume.** Plans are usually priced by tracked prompts or credits. In our experience, roughly 20-50 prompts covers a focused brand. Agencies and multi-product companies need far more.
3. **Sampling and repeat runs.** AI answers can change between runs, models, locations and dates, and in our experience they often do. Daily or weekly repeat runs show you trends. A single run is only a snapshot.
4. **Competitor tracking.** You want share of voice against named competitors, not just your own mention rate.
5. **Citations and sources.** Seeing which URLs AI tools cite tells you which publications to pitch and which pages to improve.
6. **Sentiment and accuracy.** A mention that describes your pricing or features wrongly can do more harm than no mention.
7. **Exports and API.** Check for CSV export, Looker Studio or BI connectors, and an API if you report to clients or leadership.
8. **Pricing model.** Monthly subscription, annual contract, or pay-as-you-go credits. Annual enterprise pricing suits continuous monitoring. Credits suit occasional audits.

For a deeper look at the metrics themselves, see our [AI brand visibility guide](/blog/ai-brand-visibility-guide).

## Free AI visibility tools and the manual alternative

There are a few genuinely free ways to start:

- **[Ahrefs](https://ahrefs.com/brand-radar):** a free AI visibility preview on the Brand Radar page, and paid Ahrefs plans (Lite and up) include a small daily Custom Prompts quota.
- **[AthenaHQ](https://www.athenahq.ai/pricing):** a free Essential plan with $25 of credit.
- **[Profound](https://www.tryprofound.com/pricing), [Scrunch](https://scrunch.com/pricing), [Rankscale](https://rankscale.ai/pricing), [LLMrefs](https://llmrefs.com/pricing), [Otterly.AI](https://otterly.ai/pricing), [Peec AI](https://peec.ai/pricing):** free trials, mostly 7 days.

You can also track AI visibility by hand. Write 20-30 prompts your buyers would ask, run them in each assistant, and log the results in a spreadsheet:

```
Which [category] tools would you recommend for [audience]?
What are the pros and cons of [your brand]?
Top [category] companies in [country]
```

Record the prompt, platform, date, whether you were mentioned, your position, which competitors were named, and the sources cited. Repeat monthly. It's free but slow. Our step-by-step guide on [how to track brand visibility in AI platforms](/blog/how-to-track-brand-visibility-in-ai-platforms) includes a sample log format.

## The best AI visibility tools, reviewed

### 1. AI Brand Track

*AI Brand Track is our product.*

**Best for:** teams that want a quick, repeatable AI visibility check with pay-as-you-go credits and no subscription.

You enter your website URL. The tool extracts your brand, industry and keywords, finds competitors, queries ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini with industry prompts, and returns a report in about 60 seconds. See how the [AI rank tracker](/ai-rank-tracker) works.

- **Key features:** 0-100 visibility score, competitor rankings, which prompts mention you, sentiment, share of voice, recommendations
- **Platforms:** ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini
- **Pricing:** 14-day Starter trial for $9 (1 full analysis plus weekly checks of 1 brand), then $39/mo unless cancelled. $49 for 53 credits or $149 for 220 credits, which never expire. Starter $39/mo, Pro $69/mo, Enterprise custom ([plans](/plans)).
- **Pros:** no subscription needed, a low-cost $9 trial, fast setup from just a URL
- **Cons:** covers 4 assistants and does not track Google AI Overviews or AI Mode. Re-running an analysis is manual and uses credits: there is no always-on daily monitoring and no automatic alerts, though you can save analyses and compare them over time. Newer and smaller than the enterprise platforms.

### 2. Profound

**Best for:** large brands and enterprises that want broad engine coverage and enterprise controls.

- **Key features:** Answer Engine Insights, Agent Analytics, Prompt Volumes, AI Marketer and Agents, CSV/JSON exports and API on Enterprise, ChatGPT Shopping, SSO/SAML, unlimited seats
- **Platforms:** up to 9 answer engines on Enterprise, including ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Mode, Gemini, Copilot, DeepSeek, Claude, Google AI Overviews and Exa Search
- **Pricing:** free Trial plan (50 prompts run daily for 7 days, on ChatGPT, Gemini and AI Overviews). Enterprise is custom.
- **Pros:** among the widest engine coverage listed, with an API and SSO
- **Cons:** no published price for brand plans beyond the free trial, and the trial has no exports or data history

[Visit Profound](https://www.tryprofound.com/pricing)

### 3. Peec AI

**Best for:** marketing and SEO teams that want prompt-level tracking with competitor benchmarks.

- **Key features:** daily tracking of visibility, position, sentiment and share of voice, prompt suggestions with relative prompt volume, source and citation analytics, brand perception, recommended actions, crawlability audit, CSV exports. Looker Studio integration on Advanced. API and SSO on Enterprise.
- **Platforms:** self-serve plans let you choose 3 models from a list that includes ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, AI Overviews, Microsoft Copilot and Gemini. Enterprise tracks up to 13 models, including Claude, Perplexity, Grok and DeepSeek. Extra models are available as add-ons.
- **Pricing:** Starter (50 prompts), Pro (150), Advanced (350) and Enterprise (custom, annual). See website for current prices.
- **Pros:** unlimited users on every plan, detailed source and perception reporting
- **Cons:** only 3 models on self-serve plans unless you buy add-ons, and API access is Enterprise-only

[Visit Peec AI](https://peec.ai/pricing)

### 4. Otterly.AI

**Best for:** small teams and budget-conscious marketers who want daily tracking.

- **Key features:** daily tracking, brand visibility and sentiment, citation source tracking, recommendations. API and MCP access from Standard.
- **Platforms:** ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity and Microsoft Copilot. Gemini, Google AI Mode and Claude are add-ons, priced per plan (on Lite: $9/mo each for Gemini and AI Mode, $29/mo for Claude; more on larger plans).
- **Pricing:** billed monthly, Lite is $29/mo (15 prompts), Standard $189/mo (100 prompts) and Premium $489/mo (400 prompts). Annual billing lowers these to $25, $160 and $422 per month. Free trial.
- **Pros:** low entry price, unlimited team members, tracks AI Overviews
- **Cons:** only 15 prompts on Lite, and engine add-ons raise the real cost

[Visit Otterly.AI](https://otterly.ai/pricing)

### 5. Semrush AI Visibility Toolkit

**Best for:** SEO teams already working in Semrush.

- **Key features:** AI Visibility Score, competitor research, prompt research (volume, difficulty, intent), brand performance (share of voice, sentiment, narratives), daily prompt tracking, AI search site audit
- **Platforms:** Semrush's knowledge base names "platforms like Google AI Mode and ChatGPT" without giving a full list
- **Pricing:** $99/mo with 25 tracked prompts and no free trial. Each extra user needs a $99 license. AI tracking also appears in Semrush's combined SEO and AI plans, so check the current pricing page.
- **Pros:** prompt research sits right next to your keyword data
- **Cons:** fewer engines documented than specialist tools, and per-user licensing adds up

[Semrush AI Visibility Toolkit details](https://www.semrush.com/kb/1493-ai-visibility-toolkit)

### 6. Ahrefs Brand Radar

**Best for:** Ahrefs users and teams that want market-level benchmarks without setting up prompts.

- **Key features:** Custom Prompts (daily, weekly or monthly checks), AI Visibility Index built on a large prompt database, AI Analytics for AI traffic and bots, AI Sources (YouTube, TikTok, Reddit)
- **Platforms:** AI Overviews, AI Mode, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Copilot. Custom Prompts also support Claude.
- **Pricing:** paid Ahrefs plans include a daily Custom Prompts quota (5 on Lite, 10 on Standard, 20 on Advanced). Larger Custom Prompts packages and the AI Visibility Index are paid add-ons; when we checked from Europe they were shown from €47/mo and €179/mo. See website for prices in your currency.
- **Pros:** benchmarks work with no setup, and it covers Google's AI surfaces
- **Cons:** pricing has several components, so work out your total cost before committing

[Visit Ahrefs Brand Radar](https://ahrefs.com/brand-radar)

### 7. Scrunch

**Best for:** mid-market and enterprise marketing teams.

- **Key features:** prompt management, citations and sources, site audits, sentiment, insights and recommendations, AI agent/bot traffic, page optimizations. Enterprise adds the Agent Experience Platform (AXP), API access, Looker Studio and SAML/OIDC SSO.
- **Platforms:** Core covers ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and Copilot. Enterprise covers 9 models, adding Claude, Gemini, Meta AI, Google AI Mode and Grok.
- **Pricing:** Core is $250/mo (125 prompts, 5,000 responses per month, 5 user licenses) with a 7-day free trial. Enterprise is custom.
- **Pros:** agent-traffic and site-optimization features alongside monitoring
- **Cons:** high entry price for small businesses, and Core covers only 4 engines

[Visit Scrunch](https://scrunch.com/pricing)

### 8. AthenaHQ

**Best for:** teams that want the widest model list and content actions in one platform.

- **Key features:** prompt and response analysis, sources and competitor insights, content recommendations, an AI agent, CSV export. Enterprise adds SSO and BI connectors.
- **Platforms:** Essential covers ChatGPT, Perplexity, AI Overviews, Gemini and Copilot. Starter covers 11 models, including Claude, AI Mode, Grok, DeepSeek, Meta AI and Mistral.
- **Pricing:** Essential is free with $25 of credit. Starter is $295/mo (3,600 credits, 1 credit = 1 AI response). Enterprise is custom.
- **Pros:** free entry plan, very wide model coverage on Starter
- **Cons:** API and extra credits are paid add-ons on Starter

[Visit AthenaHQ](https://www.athenahq.ai/pricing)

### 9. Rankscale

**Best for:** agencies and teams that want flexible, credit-based tracking.

- **Key features:** visibility, competitor benchmarking, citation and sentiment analysis, query fanout, CSV/Sheets export (Pro and above), REST API (Pro+ and up), white-label options (Growth)
- **Platforms (Pro and above):** ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Mode, AI Overviews, Gemini, DeepSeek, Mistral, Claude, Copilot
- **Pricing:** Essentials $17/mo (yearly only), Pro $99/mo, Pro+ $229/mo, Growth $385/mo. Unused credits roll over within limits. 7-day Pro trial.
- **Pros:** low entry point, credit rollover, agency features
- **Cons:** the full engine list and exports require Pro or higher

[Visit Rankscale](https://rankscale.ai/pricing)

### 10. LLMrefs

**Best for:** small marketing teams that want many engines on one flat plan.

- **Key features:** keyword-based tracking (it generates the prompts from your keywords), weekly AI visibility reports, citation tracking, geo-targeting in 50+ countries, prompt volume estimates, CSV export and API, unlimited team members
- **Platforms:** ChatGPT, Google AI Overview and AI Mode, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Grok, Copilot, Meta AI and DeepSeek, with no extra engine fees
- **Pricing:** one "All in One" plan at $79/mo (marked limited time) with 500 prompts. 7-day free trial.
- **Pros:** simple pricing, broad coverage
- **Cons:** reports refresh weekly rather than daily, and you track keywords rather than hand-picked prompts

[Visit LLMrefs](https://llmrefs.com/pricing)

If you're still weighing options, our article on [what to look for in an AI brand visibility tracker](/blog/ai-brand-visibility-tracker) goes deeper on features, and the [AI search visibility](/ai-search-visibility) page explains the core concepts.

## FAQ

### What are the best AI visibility tools for 2026?

Options worth comparing include Profound, Peec AI, Otterly.AI, Scrunch, AthenaHQ, Rankscale, LLMrefs, the Semrush AI Visibility Toolkit, Ahrefs Brand Radar and AI Brand Track. The best one depends on your budget, the AI platforms you need covered, and how many prompts you'll track. Enterprises that need broad coverage should look at the enterprise platforms, while smaller teams can start with lower-cost or pay-as-you-go tools.

### What is the best AI visibility platform?

No single platform is best for everyone. If you need many engines plus SSO and an API, look at enterprise tools such as [Profound](https://www.tryprofound.com/pricing), [Scrunch](https://scrunch.com/pricing) or [AthenaHQ](https://www.athenahq.ai/pricing). If you already use [Semrush](https://www.semrush.com/kb/1493-ai-visibility-toolkit) or [Ahrefs](https://ahrefs.com/brand-radar), their add-ons keep everything in one place. If you want occasional checks without a subscription, a credit-based tool fits better.

### How to monitor AI visibility?

Define a fixed set of prompts your buyers would ask, run them on each AI assistant regularly, and record mentions, position, competitors, sentiment and cited sources. Because answers can vary between runs, watch trends over time rather than single results. You can do this manually in a spreadsheet or automate it with an AI visibility tool.

### How do you increase AI visibility?

Make sure AI crawlers can access your pages, write answer-first content with clear facts, keep your brand description consistent across profiles, and earn mentions in the third-party sources AI tools cite for your category. Then measure the effect with repeat tracking.

### What is AI visibility?

AI visibility is how often and how favorably AI assistants like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Claude mention your brand when people ask relevant questions. It's usually measured by mention rate, position, share of voice against competitors, sentiment and citations.

### Are there free AI visibility tools?

Yes, with limits. [Ahrefs has a free AI visibility preview](https://ahrefs.com/brand-radar), and [AthenaHQ has a free Essential plan](https://www.athenahq.ai/pricing) with starter credit. Most of the other tools reviewed above list free trials. The fully free alternative is manual prompt testing logged in a spreadsheet. If you'd like to see your own baseline, AI Brand Track offers a [14-day trial for $9](/plans?checkout=starter-monthly).
